subject: Request: ZenFlow pilot incentive (discount + credits) — exec signoff
messages:
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: ZenFlow pilot — request for combined credit + discount exception (deal ZF-2026-092)

Hi Marissa / Aditya —

Quick ask: ZenFlow is ready to sign a 12-month commit that would convert to a $450k ARR account after the pilot, but procurement is pushing for a two-week signature window and requesting a commercial sweetener to choose us over a competitor. They want a 90-day extension of the trial window and an upfront credit pool to offset eval usage.

Ask: approval to offer a one-time package for this pilot: 30% first-year discount on committed spend + $50,000 in free hosted credits applied to the pilot, with the following guardrails:
- Pilot window extended to 90 days (standard is 30)
- Credits apply to tokens, not support/third-party fees
- Discount applies only to the first 12 months once they convert
- Customer must sign the (attached) MSA + mutual action plan by Friday 2026-09-10

Why this is strategic: ZenFlow is a strong reference in financial services, they already have 3 product teams engaged (NLP, search, summarization) and indicate potential to multi-team rollouts in 2027. Our intake shows competitor X is offering a deeper discount but no dedicated onboarding; the credits + extension are a low-risk way to win without further long-term pricing erosion.

Impact summary (high level):
- Expected conversion probability increase: +35%
- Estimated pure revenue at risk vs. upsell opportunity: ~$450k ARR (net-new)
- Near-term ledger impact: credits ~$50k (one-time), margin hit depends on usage profile (see attached cost_impact_analysis.xlsx)

Attachments: ZenFlow_Quote_v3.pdf, zenflow_mutual_action_plan.xlsx, cost_impact_analysis.xlsx

I need an exec signoff to move forward and get DocuSign sent today. If you want a quicker option, I can reduce the discount and keep credits.

Thanks —
Elliot
Elliot Price
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ZenFlow_Quote_v3.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]
[Attachment: zenflow_mutual_action_plan.xlsx (XLSX, 85KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ZenFlow pilot — request for combined credit + discount exception (deal ZF-2026-092)

Elliot —

Thanks for the write-up. A few clarifying questions before I sign off:
1) Can you confirm the committed minimum (if they convert) and any ramp assumptions used in the cost impact spreadsheet?
2) Who on their side is the procurement contact and have we pulled their SOC2/Security questionnaire yet? I want security scoped if this becomes multi-team.
3) Could we structure this so credits are drawdown-only for pilot usage and don’t offset contractual minimums? That protects recurring revenue.

Initial thought: 30% + $50k is material. I'm open to supporting this if we tighten the conditions: limit credits to pilot-only (no offset to minimum), require signature by 9/10, and add a commitment to a post-pilot roadmap review with product/CS. Also, legal should sign off on the MSA redlines.

Aditya — can you run a quick margin and GAAP impact and suggest a recommended compromise (thresholds) by EOD? Grace — please prep a 1-pager onboarding plan we can hand to ZenFlow once approved.

If the numbers look acceptable, I'll provide an exec approval email we can forward to the customer.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ZenFlow pilot — request for combined credit + discount exception (deal ZF-2026-092)

Marissa / Elliot —

Quick calc from finance ops attached (cost_impact_analysis.xlsx). TL;DR:
- $50k credits (token consumption) expected gross margin hit in pilot ~ $18k at current mix; potential overage if they spike, but pilot-only credits reduce long-term revenue erosion.
- 30% discount on first-year ARR at $450k ACV reduces year-1 revenue by ~$135k; on a ~60% gross margin baseline that's ~ $81k gross margin reduction.
- Combined (credits + discount) worst-case margin impact year-1: ~ $99k.

Recommendation: Approve a middle ground to balance win probability and margin: approve 25% first-year discount + $40k pilot credits, with conditions:
- Credits expire after 90 days and only apply to hosting token usage
- Credits do not apply to the contractual minimum if they sign annual commit
- Procurement must sign MSA & mutual action plan by 2026-09-10
- If they commit to ≥$500k ARR within 12 months, issue a rebate equivalent to 50% of used credits back as credits for year-2 (protects our renewal economics)

If Marissa signs off on those terms, I can draft the approval language and run it past legal within 2 hours.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: cost_impact_analysis.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T09:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ZenFlow pilot — request for combined credit + discount exception (deal ZF-2026-092)

Thanks Aditya — that recommendation makes sense. Approve the exception on the following final conditions:
- 25% first-year discount on committed spend (as defined in the attached quote)
- $40,000 one-time hosted credits for the pilot (90-day expiry)
- Credits exclude contractual minimums and third-party costs
- MSA + mutual action plan must be fully executed by 2026-09-10; if not, approvals are void
- Add a post-pilot business review with CS and Product within 30 days of pilot completion

Elliot — please confirm the customer understands these constraints and update the quote. Once you confirm, I will send a short exec approval note you can include in the DocuSign package.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
[Internal approval note: Approved by VP Sales on 2026-09-08 09:33 PST]

Subject: Approved: ZenFlow pilot package & next steps (ZF-2026-092)

Soren — great news. Leadership has approved a tailored pilot package to help ZenFlow accelerate evaluation. Summary of approved terms: 
- 25% discount on the first 12 months of committed spend if ZenFlow executes the attached MSA and quote
- $40,000 in one-time hosted credits applied to pilot token usage (90-day expiry)
- Credits do not offset contractual minimums and exclude third-party charges
- Signature target: MSA + mutual action plan completed by 2026-09-10

Next steps:
1) I have attached the updated ZenFlow_Quote_v3.pdf that reflects the approved pricing.
2) Please confirm procurement contact for routing (if different from this thread).
3) Once you confirm, we'll route DocuSign with the exec approval note and onboarding 1-pager. 

If procurement needs any additional evidence (SOC2, network diagram), please let me know and we will expedite. We’re excited to get ZenFlow onboarded and will assign a dedicated CS touchpoint once the MSA is signed.

Thanks —
Elliot
Elliot Price
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
